p.title: v59.94 command guard denied an index-only unstage and allowed a forced push with a quoted +refspec
p.symptom: The agent command guard denied an index-only restore of the whole tree (it only unstages; nothing is lost), and let through forced pushes whose refspec was quoted with a leading plus.
p.root_cause: The whole-tree discard rule matched every restore of '.', whatever its flags; the push rule required the plus right after whitespace, so a quote before it hid the force marker.
p.fix: The whole-tree rule carries an exemption predicate for a restore with --staged/-S and neither --worktree nor -W (clustered short flags read too, so -SW stays denied); the push rule accepts an optional quote before the plus. A plus inside a refspec (HEAD:+main, a+b) is not a force marker and stays allowed.
p.violated_rule: A guard rule matches the operation's effect, not one spelling of it.
p.prevention: Workspace contract fixtures: deny the three quoted forced pushes, a staged-plus-worktree restore and -SW; allow --staged, -S, --source=HEAD --staged, a+b, HEAD:main and HEAD:+main. Every earlier fixture keeps its result.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-workspace-contract-check.mjs prints Workspace contract OK; with the old agent-hook.mjs the three quoted-push denies and the three index-only allows fail.

changelog: **Command guard ({P}):** an index-only restore now passes the guard because it only unstages, and a forced push whose refspec is quoted is denied like an unquoted one.
note: v59.94: guard allows unstage, denies quoted +refspec
